sections.summary: The layer face adopts the recipe's font stack, the mapped body colors, and Tailwind's spacing on the shared `mb-*` and `pb-*` names. Through curated copies it keeps headings, display headings, `lead`, `mark`, `initialism`, the blockquote, inline lists, and the description list's `text-truncate`, and it removes the `dl` and `dd` margins as that card's caption states. Bootstrap stops working in one place: a list nested in `list-unstyled` loses its bullets and indent. Two departures have no caption: bare paragraphs lose their 16px margin, and the footer `code` element grows from 12.25px to 14px.

The Morning ferry and Evening ferry items lose their circle bullets and 2rem indent, so they read as siblings of Lisbon departures. The `list-unstyled` helper then appears to strip every level, although Bootstrap documents that it reaches only the immediate children. No caption in the typography section states this. The same groups 0 and 1 appear in digest/light-1280, dark-390, and dark-1280 typography.json. Source: `git -C /home/user/veneer show 426d08d:app/browser/sections/typography.html` (nested `ul` inside `ul.list-unstyled`, no layer caption on that card); `git show 426d08d:src/tailwindcss/_tokens.scss` lines 355–392 (`$curated` holds `list-unstyled`, which matches only the classed outer list); `git show 426d08d:src/bootstrap/_reset.scss` lines 151–172 (the reboot's `ol, ul` rule sets padding-left 2rem and no list-style).
findings.fix: Add a `$scoped` entry `'list-unstyled': ('ul', 'ol')` in src/tailwindcss/_tokens.scss. Rule out a caption alone: it leaves the helper's own documented example misrendered. Also rule out a Tailwind companion class on the nested list: the card's markup policy forbids a companion class that hides a departure.

refutations.reason:
The finding holds as a layer DEFECT, but for a narrower reason than the reviewer gives. Under the layer, every link-utility anchor loses its underline and its link color. The anchors take preflight's inherited table color: black in light mode, white in the dark swatch. That leaves the `link-underline`, `link-underline-{color}`, `link-underline-opacity-*`, `link-opacity-*`, and `link-offset-*` helpers with no visible effect. No caption in the section states this, and the layer already holds the underline for the sibling `link-{color}` classes, so a Bootstrap page author would call it broken.

The reviewer's sentence "The colored underline is the subject of the card, and it no longer renders" is wrong. The colored underline does not render under the Bootstrap face either. Every underline in the Bootstrap face's Underline colors card is drawn in the link color, because the showcase template adds `link-underline` to every specimen. In Bootstrap's sheet, `.link-underline` follows `.link-underline-danger` and the other color rules, with equal specificity and `!important`, so it wins in every face. That half is a showcase defect, not the layer's, and the proposed curated-list fix alone does not bring the colors back.
